structured_output.summary:
No material ship blocker found in commit 7eb8a40. This is read-only analysis of the patches and surrounding code. I ran no tests or probes.

- Pre-spawn ownership: removing the unconditional killpg(pgid, SIGKILL) when process is None (lib/_docguardian.py:178-180) is sound. A checkpoint PGID is not an owned signal capability before spawn. The parent's unreaped GroupPin child still owns the group, and run() still SIGKILLs via pin.signal_group after the guardian dies (_docguardian.py:279-283, 295-299).
- Spawn handle window: in lib/_docgroup_pin.py:76-80, pid is assigned inside defer_launch_signals. The guardian wraps spawn_in_group in its own defer_launch_signals and passes signal_mask=previous (_docguardian.py:92-94). Pending SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP can only be delivered at the outer exit, after process is bound, so I found no window with a live unowned child.
- Replay failure evidence: in lib/_docexamples.py:230-244, the try now covers the input.json write and guardian.run. Evidence is recovered from initial.json and terminal.json only when run_id matches. A completed or missing reason is forced to guardian-failure, so line 304 (reason != completed) keeps the stage non-complete. Recovery runs before TemporaryDirectory removal.
next_steps: Optionally confirm the new tests in tests/a2/test_guardian.py and test_examples_cli.py inject faults at the posix_spawn return and at the outer defer_launch_signals exit.
